summary: Native admission reads independently sampled PSI decisions and retains specific pressure, recovery, and observation failure reasons.

schema.detail: Local resource memberships may retain an optional tagged pressure reason. No SQL migration or client-v0 schema change.

rules.detail: Only the daemon sampler observes admission PSI, every five seconds with delayed missed ticks. Admission reads the cached decision and closes when it is older than the existing ten-second freshness window. Pressure thresholds and 120-second recovery hysteresis are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing resource membership records remain readable; existing status reason text carries details without changing client-v0.

recovery.detail: Fresh healthy sampler observations recover admission through the existing hysteresis window.
